notesAboutQuality: The attached alternate HTML files were used as a visual design reference only; their note data was not trusted.
This is a simplified educational melody arrangement, not a complete score.
Practice mode remains the deliberately simplified nine-group guitar/celesta study; Full Rendition is a separate complete 18-part symbolic-score ingestion.
The vendored orchestral witness contains 52 linear 2/4 measures, 18 source parts, and 1,824 note events; source part/staff/voice identities are preserved.
